Senior Software Engineer Technical Remediation & Enablement
location: New York New York United States
description_html: The Applications Development Technology Lead Analyst is a senior level position responsible for establishing and implementing new or revised application systems and programs in coordination with the Technology team. The overall objective of this role is to lead applications systems analysis and programming activities.    Responsibilities:     Partner with multiple management teams to ensure appropriate integration of functions to meet goals as well as identify and define necessary system enhancements to deploy new products and process improvements  Resolve variety of high impact problems/projects through in-depth evaluation of complex business processes, system processes, and industry standards  Provide expertise in area and advanced knowledge of applications programming and ensure application design adheres to the overall architecture blueprint  Utilize advanced knowledge of system flow and develop standards for coding, testing, debugging, and implementation  Develop comprehensive knowledge of how areas of business, such as architecture and infrastructure, integrate to accomplish business goals  Provide in-depth analysis with interpretive thinking to define issues and develop innovative solutions  Serve as advisor or coach to mid-level developers and analysts, allocating work as necessary  Appropriately assess risk when business decisions are made, demonstrating particular consideration for the firm's reputation and safeguarding Citigroup, its clients and assets, by driving compliance with applicable laws, rules and regulations, adhering to Policy, applying sound ethical judgment regarding personal behavior, conduct and business practices, and escalating, managing and reporting control issues with transparency.      Recommended Qualifications:     6-10 years of relevant experience in Apps Development or systems analysis role  Extensive experience system analysis and in programming of software applications  Experience in managing and implementing successful projects  Subject Matter Expert (SME) in at least one area of Applications Development  Ability to adjust priorities quickly as circumstances dictate  Demonstrated leadership and project management skills  Consistently demonstrates clear and concise written and verbal communication      Education:     Bachelor’s degree/University degree or equivalent experience  Master’s degree preferred      This job description provides a high-level review of the types of work performed. Other job-related duties may be assigned as required.    The  Vice President (VP) / Senior Software Engineer – Technical Remediation & Enablement Lead  is a hands-on, code-level technical specialist responsible for driving the direct remediation of software vulnerabilities across enterprise application teams. This individual contributor / team-level technical lead works alongside application developers and contractor engineers to fix static code vulnerabilities (SAST), patch vulnerable software dependencies (SCA/third-party libraries), containerize workloads, and streamline local build/release pipelines to achieve  same-day vulnerability hotfix and deployment capabilities .  This role combines active software engineering (writing/refactoring code and debugging pipelines) with technical enablement, guiding squad developers on how to adopt internal security and build tools, resolve tricky dependency conflicts, and package applications into modern containers for rapid, low-risk production releases.   Key Responsibilities & Core Duties    1. Hands-On Code Remediation & Dependency Patching    Write, refactor, and review application code to directly remediate static code analysis (SAST) findings (e.g., SQL/command injection, cross-site scripting, insecure deserialization, improper error handling, weak cryptography).  Resolve complex third-party library and framework upgrades (SCA/CVE remediation), managing transitive dependency conflicts, breaking API changes, and version incompatibilities across Java, Python, Go, .NET, or JavaScript/TypeScript stacks.  Implement targeted automated unit, integration, and regression tests to validate that code fixes and patched libraries do not introduce functional regressions.    2. Containerization & Same-Day Release Enablement    Work directly in application repositories to write and optimize  Dockerfile s, container manifests, and base image configurations (Docker, OCI, Kubernetes/OpenShift).  Assist application squads in containerizing non-containerized legacy services, establishing minimal base images and automated base-image rebuild triggers for same-day OS/runtime patching.  Help configure and fine-tune CI/CD build scripts and release pipelines to compress deployment cycle times and eliminate manual deployment steps for emergency hotfixes.    3. Application Plan Technical Validation    Perform code-level reviews of proposed remediation plans from application teams, verifying whether proposed library version bumps or refactored logic effectively eliminate the root cause of the vulnerability.  Identify technical prerequisites (e.g., test coverage gaps, build tool upgrades, compiler/runtime updates) needed before a team can successfully patch and release.    4. Contractor Squad Pairing & PR Review    Act as a peer reviewer and technical guide for external contractor engineers assigned to assist with remediation work.  Review contractor-submitted pull requests (PRs) for code cleanliness, security correctness, test coverage, and enterprise architectural standards.  Facilitate smooth technical onboarding and repository access for contractor developers.    5. Internal Tooling Adoption & Developer Feedback    Actively pilot, adopt, and demonstrate internal developer tools, IDE security plugins, automated PR bots (e.g., Dependabot/Renovate patterns), and local scanning utilities within engineering squads.  Troubleshoot false positives, scanner configuration errors, and build pipeline failures; provide direct, actionable feedback to internal platform and tooling teams to improve developer experience.    Required Qualifications & Experience    Education & Experience Requirements     Bachelor’s Degree  in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, or related technical field.   4–7 years  of hands-on software development and engineering experience delivering enterprise web applications, microservices, or distributed backend systems.  Proven track record of directly fixing static code vulnerabilities (SAST) and managing third-party dependency/package upgrades in production environments.  Practical, hands-on experience containerizing applications and working with container orchestration platforms (Docker, Kubernetes, OpenShift).    Technical Proficiencies     Core Programming Languages:  Strong, hands-on development proficiency in at least one or two primary enterprise languages:  Java (Spring Boot), Python, Go, C#/.NET, or TypeScript/Node.js .   Static Code Analysis (SAST):  Ability to analyze and fix scanner findings from tools such as  SonarQube, Checkmarx, Veracode, or Fortify .   Dependency & Package Management:  Practical experience with dependency resolution and build tools:  Maven, Gradle, npm/yarn, NuGet, pip/Poetry, or Go modules , alongside SCA tools like  Snyk, Black Duck, or JFrog Xray .   Containers & Runtime:  Hands-on experience creating production-grade  Dockerfile s, managing multi-stage builds, patching container base images, and deploying to  Kubernetes or OpenShift .   CI/CD & Version Control:  Proficient with  Git , branching strategies (Gitflow/trunk-based), and pipeline configurations (e.g., Jenkins, GitHub Actions, Tekton, GitLab CI, Harness).    Core Competencies & Working Style    Competency    Behavioral Expectation    Hands-On Craftsmanship   Loves writing code, debugging builds, untangling messy dependency trees, and seeing clean PRs merged to production.   Developer-to-Developer Empathy   Speaks the language of squad engineers, troubleshoots shoulder-to-shoulder, and offers practical solutions rather than abstract advice.   Pragmatic Problem Solver   Able to quickly find safe workarounds or code refactors when direct library upgrades introduce breaking API changes.   Clear Communication   Explains the "why" and "how" of security fixes clearly in PR comments, documentation, and pairing sessions.   Key Performance Indicators (Success Metrics)     Direct Remediation Output:  Number of validated PRs merged and critical/high vulnerabilities (SAST & SCA) successfully resolved across assigned services.   Same-Day Hotfix Readiness:  Number of application components successfully containerized and equipped with automated verification pipelines capable of same-day hotfix releases.   Turnaround Time for Technical Reviews:  Fast, reliable review turnaround for application remediation plans and contractor pull requests.   Build & Release Optimization:  Measurable reduction in build and deployment friction for patched releases within supported application squads.                ------------------------------------------------------                Job Family Group:   Technology              ------------------------------------------------------                Job Family:  Applications Development            ------------------------------------------------------              Time Type:  Full time            ------------------------------------------------------              Primary Location:  New York New York United States            ------------------------------------------------------              Primary Location Full Time Salary Range:  $142,320.00 - $213,480.00  In addition to salary, Citi’s offerings may also include, for eligible employees, discretionary and formulaic incentive and retention awards. title: Sr ML Engineer, Admin Central
description_html: Your work days are brighter here.     We’re obsessed with making hard work pay off, for our people, our customers, and the world around us. As a Fortune 500 company and a leading AI platform for managing people, money, and agents, we’re shaping the future of work so teams can reach their potential and focus on what matters most. The minute you join, you’ll feel it. Not just in the products we build, but in how we show up for each other. Our culture is rooted in integrity, empathy, and shared enthusiasm. We’re in this together, tackling big challenges with bold ideas and genuine care. We look for curious minds and courageous collaborators who bring sun-drenched optimism and drive. Whether you're building smarter solutions, supporting customers, or creating a space where everyone belongs, you’ll do meaningful work with Workmates who’ve got your back. In return, we’ll give you the trust to take risks, the tools to grow, the skills to develop and the support of a company invested in you for the long haul. So, if you want to inspire a brighter work day for everyone, including yourself, you’ve found a match in Workday, and we hope to be a match for you too.           About the Team  We are hiring Sr ML Engineers across two teams.  Admin Central is building the future of how administrators work across Workday—turning a fragmented patchwork of tools and disconnected AI into a single, unified experience. Within Admin Central, Workday implementations move from being driven by human effort to being powered by intelligence designed into the platform.  The Business Process Optimize (BPO) team powers the underlying platform infrastructure. You’ll build mission-critical distributed systems, high-availability usage pipelines, new agentic functionality, and event-driven data flows across global product regions to ensure enterprise billing integrity at scale. If you're excited to build from scratch, move fast, and transform how thousands of admins work every day, come join us!    About the Role     Key Responsibilities    ML Infrastructure & Pipeline Engineering:  Architect, deploy, and maintain end-to-end Machine Learning pipelines—from distributed data ingestion and feature engineering to model training, evaluation, and production deployment.   Agentic AI & Recommendation Engines:  Design algorithms and LLM-driven recommendation features (e.g., IDD insights, next-best-action models) that optimize agentic workflows and tool usage.   Low-Latency Inference & Scaling:  Optimize real-time model inference and scoring microservices to ensure sub-second response times across high-concurrency multi-tenant environments.   LLM & Agentic Observability:  Integrate telemetry and tracing (OpenTelemetry, LangChain, LangSmith) into ML pipelines to track model performance, prompt/response drift, and execution efficiency.   Data & Feature Store Architecture:  Collaborate with core backend engineers to leverage big data platforms (ClickHouse, Apache Iceberg, Spark) for high-dimensional feature retrieval and analytics.   Cross-Functional Leadership:  Partner closely with Product Managers, Data Engineering, SRE, and Legal/Compliance to translate complex business and governance requirements into scalable ML solutions.       About You     Basic Qualifications    8+ years  of experience in machine learning development, researching, developing, and implementing advanced machine learning models and techniques, with at least  4+ years  focused explicitly on building, deploying, and operating production Machine Learning systems at scale.   5+ years  of experience and proficiency in deep learning, natural language processing (NLP), and GenAI/LLM orchestration, utilizing frameworks and libraries such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, Scikit-learn, LangChain, and LlamaIndex, alongside proficiency in Java, Go, Scala, or C++ for high-performance backend systems.    Other Qualifications    Data Processing & Pipelines:  Strong ability in distributed processing (Spark, Flink, Kafka) and high-throughput columnar/vector storage (ClickHouse, Pinecone, Milvus) to design robust ML data pipelines.   AI/ML Expertise:  Solid knowledge of RAG architectures, LLM fine-tuning, intent classification, and recommendation engines—applying ML algorithms and Model-Based Design (including MCP tooling and structured agentic execution paths) to multi-agent orchestration, contextual reasoning, and workflow optimization.   Data Analysis & Feature Engineering:  Experience leading EDA on multi-tenant execution logs to validate prompt/response accuracy and optimize tool usage, paired with strong feature engineering skills for vector embeddings, feature stores, and multi-tenant data isolation.   Model Lifecycle:  Experience leading model building (foundation model adaptation, prompt engineering, fine-tuning, low-latency inference) and deep understanding of the model development lifecycle, including MLOps platforms (Kubeflow, MLflow, Airflow, SageMaker) for monitoring, latency tracking, and retraining at scale.   Technical Stack:  Strong proficiency in Python and ML libraries (PyTorch, TensorFlow, NumPy, Pandas, Scikit-learn, LangChain, LangSmith, DSPy), with experience deploying scalable ML systems in cloud-native production using Docker, Kubernetes, gRPC/REST APIs, and CI/CD under strict high-availability (99.9% uptime) and low-latency SLAs.   Team Collaboration:  Strong ability to mentor team members, drive cross-functional technical alignment, draft system design specs/model cards, and communicate technical and governance decisions.   Education:  Bachelor's in Computer Science, Data Science, Machine Learning, Applied Mathematics, Statistics, or Engineering; Master's or PhD strongly preferred. As a part of the total compensation package, this role may be eligible for the Workday Bonus Plan or a role-specific commission/bonus, as well as annual refresh stock grants. Each candidate’s compensation offer will be based on multiple factors including, but not limited to, geography, experience, skills, job duties, and business need, among other things. Primary Location: USA.CA.Pleasanton    Primary Location Base Pay Range:  $192,000 USD - $288,000 USD    Additional US Location(s) Base Pay Range: $163,000 USD - $288,000 USD    Our Approach to Flexible Work      With Flex Work, we’re combining the best of both worlds: in-person time and remote. Our approach enables our teams to deepen connections, maintain a strong community, and do their best work. We know that flexibility can take shape in many ways, so rather than a number of required days in-office each week, we simply   spend at least half (50%) of our time each quarter in the office or in the field   with our customers, prospects, and partners (depending on role). This means you'll have the freedom to create a flexible schedule that caters to your business, team, and personal needs, while being intentional to make the most of time spent together. title: Staff Software Engineer, AI Developer Experience
Senior / Staff Software Engineer, Data Infrastructure
description_html:
ABOUT SUNO

We're building the world's first creative entertainment platform, where the entire world can feel the joy and fulfillment of making music. Music is for everyone: Our users include everyone from grandmothers creating songs for their loved ones, to Grammy winners using Suno Studio, our power tool, to make the most popular hits in the world.

Building the future of entertainment requires ambition. The pace is fast, the problems are hard, and the work demands ownership and intensity. For the right people, it’s incredibly rewarding: a chance to shape a new medium, work with a small team that cares deeply about quality, make music, drink too much coffee, and build something that millions of people use to express themselves in ways that were never before possible.

Suno is the fastest growing consumer entertainment company and the leader in AI music. We are backed by leading investors including Bond Capital, Menlo Ventures, Lightspeed Venture Partners, IVP, Forerunner, Union Square Ventures, Alkeon, Quiet, Matrix Partners, Schroders Capital and, NVentures (venture arm of NVIDIA).




ABOUT THE ROLE

Suno is growing fast, and we’re hiring Staff and Senior Software Engineers to build and scale the foundational systems that power our data platform and personalized recommendations. You’ll design and operate infrastructure that ingests, processes, and serves PBs of data, helping connect listeners with music they love while supporting analytics, experimentation, and machine learning across the company.

This is a high-impact, senior role at the intersection of Data Infrastructure and ML. You’ll partner closely with Engineering, Data, and ML teams to build the pipelines, feature infrastructure, and low-latency data services that power recommendations and music discovery. Your work will help turn user interactions and content signals into reliable, fresh data for model training and real-time personalization.

As Suno grows, you’ll help define the long-term architecture of our data platform, balancing scalability, reliability, latency, and cost. You’ll build systems that are observable and easy to extend, enabling teams to experiment quickly and improve how people discover and engage with music. You’ll own major systems end to end, from design through production operation, and drive architecture and technical direction across teams.

Check out the Suno version of this role here: https://suno.com/s/yt9eiMi9aj0rmGX6




WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Build and scale the data infrastructure behind personalized recommendations and music discovery, working closely with ML and product engineers.

 - Design streaming pipelines that transform user interactions and content signals into fresh features for recommendation models.

 - Develop infrastructure for computing, storing, and serving features across offline model training and online inference, with attention to consistency, reliability, and latency.

 - Enable recommendation experimentation through reliable impression and interaction logging, supporting model evaluation and measurement of recommendation quality.

 - Own the architecture and reliability of core streaming and batch infrastructure, using technologies such as Kinesis, Firehose, Lambda, S3, Flink, and Glue.

 - Build and maintain data workflows and orchestration using Dagster, ensuring pipelines are modular, testable, and observable.

 - Partner with backend and product engineers to define event schemas, data contracts, and ingestion patterns from production systems.

 - Improve the reliability and observability of data pipelines through monitoring, alerting, lineage tracking, and automated recovery mechanisms.

 - Optimize pipelines and storage for performance, cost efficiency, and scalability across AWS and Snowflake.

 - Implement infrastructure as code (e.g., Terraform) to manage AWS and Snowflake resources in a consistent, reproducible way.

 - Contribute to data platform standards, including schema evolution, data quality enforcement, and pipeline reliability best practices.

 - Lead technical design discussions and help shape the future architecture of Suno’s data platform.

 - Mentor other engineers and raise the bar for engineering quality, reliability, and maintainability.
   


WHAT YOU’LL NEED

 - 7+ years of relevant experience in software engineering, data infrastructure, or distributed systems.

 - Strong programming skills, preferably in Python, and experience building and operating production-grade distributed systems.

 - Deep experience building and operating real-time streaming and batch processing systems.

 - Experience building data or serving infrastructure for recommendations, personalization, search, or similar ML-powered product experiences.

 - Understanding of feature computation, online/offline data consistency, and the latency and freshness requirements of production ML systems.

 - Experience with streaming and cloud data infrastructure, such as Flink, Kinesis, Kafka, or equivalent technologies.

 - Experience designing reliable, observable systems, including monitoring, logging, alerting, and recovery.

 - Strong understanding of data modeling, schema evolution, and data quality.

 - Ability to collaborate closely with ML, data, and product engineering teams, make pragmatic technical decisions, and deliver in ambiguous environments.

 - A strong sense of ownership, with a track record of delivering scalable infrastructure and improving engineering practices.

Excitement about music, creativity, and AI, and the infrastructure that helps people create and discover music.




NICE TO HAVE

 - Experience with AWS services such as Kinesis, Firehose, Lambda, S3, and Glue.

 - Experience with Snowflake or a similar cloud data warehouse, including performance and cost optimization.

 - Experience with Dagster, Airflow, or similar orchestration frameworks.

 - Experience with dbt for transformations, testing, and modular data modeling.

 - Experience with Terraform or similar infrastructure-as-code tools.
   


ADDITIONAL NOTES

 - Applicants must be eligible to work in the US.

 - This role requires working from our Cambridge, MA or New York, NY office five days per week.




COMPENSATION

The annual salary range for this role is $228,960 - 363,510 + target equity + benefits (including medical, dental, vision, and 401k)





PERKS & BENEFITS FOR FULL-TIME EMPLOYEES

 - Company Equity Package

 - 401(k) with 3% Employer Match & Roth 401(k)

 - Medical, Dental, & Vision Insurance (PPO w/ HSA & FSA options)

 - 11 Paid Holidays + Unlimited PTO & Sick Time

 - 16 Weeks of Paid Parental Leave

 - Creative Education Stipend

 - Generous Commuter Allowance

Job Description:        HPE is seeking a   Cloud Software Engineer   to work in our San Jose, California office on a hybrid schedule.        The   Cloud Software Engineer   will build from the ground up to meet the needs of mission-critical applications, and is always looking for innovative approaches to deliver end-to-end technical solutions to solve customer problems.     The   Cloud Software Engineer   will bring technical thinking to break down complex data and to engineer new ideas and methods for solving, prototyping, designing, and implementing cloud-based solutions.  The   Cloud Software Engineer   will collaborate with project managers and development partners to ensure effective and efficient delivery, deployment, operation, monitoring, and support of Cloud engagements. Designs and develops moderate to complex cloud application modules per feature specifications adhering to security policies.  Identifies debugs and creates solutions for issues with code and integration into application architecture.  Develops and executes comprehensive test plans for features adhering to performance, scale, usability, and security requirements.  Deploy cloud-based systems and applications code using continuous integration/deployment (CI/CD) pipelines to automate cloud applications' management, scaling, and deployment.  Contributes towards innovation and integration of new technologies into projects.  Analyzes science, engineering, business, and other data processing problems to develop and implement solutions to complex application problems, system administration issues, or network concerns.             Education and Experience Required:     Bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, information systems, or closely related quantitative discipline. Good understanding of distributed systems, event-driven programming paradigms, and designing for scale and performance.  Experience with cloud-native applications, developer tools, managed services, and next-generation databases.  Knowledge of DevOps practices like CI/CD, infrastructure as code, containerization, and orchestration using Kubernetes.  Good written and verbal communication skills and agile in a changing environment.
